rationale: The initial compiled smoke selected the first CSS-visible .arcade-portal-return. In Game033 pause the native dialog is modal, so the underlying header is inert even though Playwright CSS visibility is true. All four timeout logs explicitly identify the top-layer .arcade-modal-return inside open dialog#menu as intercepting the selected header anchor. public/arcade-navigation.js intentionally provides this top-layer native return link and forwards its click to the existing header save/quit path. Independently viewed initial desktop failure PNG shows the active upper-left return action above the modal backdrop. The collector correction changes only leave-target selection to prefer the open-dialog return action. On identical 57dce249 source the corrected production rerun passes all four widths with 198 checks, zero failures/page errors/POSTs and unchanged source hashes. Dedicated Game033 native runs separately recorded normal portal return at all four widths. This evidence establishes a collector target-selection failure and does not require a production-source change.
